findings: `components[1]` and its learner card call 不 a proposed phonetic component, but the same cited research offers a competing interpretation of 不 as a semantic remnant of a hollowed tree (X-e489a233b84d0dcb9cf1), while the evidence for its phonetic role concerns particular Warring States forms and leaves its earliest role unsettled (X-9d148883a97b1e30bf85, X-c7b847ae4fc878199ac8). Revise the cards and `formation.type` to present the competing constructions distinctly and qualify the proposed sound analysis at its stated scope; do not imply phonosemantic formation is settled for the character as a whole. The learner overview also needs the current visible split 木 + 不 explained without presenting the disputed historical role as certain.
